description: The full ConferenceFindr listing for one event: dates, venue, audience, organizer, size, every published ticket price tier with the date we checked it, and how its price and size compare with its industry. The id is the last part of the event's ConferenceFindr link, e.g. "promat" in conferencefindr.com/events/promat.

id.description: The event's id, from its ConferenceFindr link

name: get_event
title: Get a conference's verified listing
